# Table reading test

| Feature | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :---: | --- |
| **Pages** | Ready | Read a full screen per swipe. Keep one line of overlap to follow the next page easily. |
| Autoscroll | Ready | Adjust the speed with a swipe.<br>Pause with a tap. |
| File imports | | Choose `.md` files on your phone. Pipes such as A\|B stay in the same cell. |

## After the table

Table cells stay searchable. A saved position can return to a wrapped value.

The reading controls work the same way for paragraphs and table records.

More text follows so every table cell can be selected as the starting line.

The phone keeps the original Markdown file in its local library.

The glasses receive native text, one screen at a time.

The end of the example.
